message.content: Keeping processing local does not remove all data protection responsibilities because the organization that creates and distributes the model is still considered a controller. This means they determine the means and purposes of processing, even if the personal data involved in training is being processed on the user's device. Additionally, the organization must assess the impact of their processing on individuals and demonstrate that there is a compelling benefit to the processing. They must also be able to show the necessity and proportionality of the processing.
